note: Rung 4: curated per-card rules. Each entry is keyed by (cardKey, face, clauseSha256) where clauseSha256 = sha256 of sourceClause, the exact normalized clause the extractor produces. An entry applies only when the grammar leaves that clause unclassified, unless override is true. An entry whose clause no longer exists is stale and fails the run; an entry for a clause the grammar now classifies is redundant and is reported for pruning. PROTOTYPE entries: not yet owner-reviewed.

entries.title: Swarming Vulture Droid
entries.sourceClause: A deck can have up to 15 copies of this card.
entries.rationale: Deckbuilding rule, not an in-game effect; scores 0 in the effect sum but marks the card as a swarm enabler.

entries.title: Qui-Gon Jinn
entries.sourceClause: Its owner puts it on the top or bottom of their deck.
entries.rationale: Removal-like tuck of the unit chosen in the preceding clause; treated like a bounce for pairing because a friendly target can be replayed later.

entries.title: ISB Agent
entries.sourceClause: You may reveal an event from your hand.
entries.rationale: Optional reveal of an event card from hand; it only gates the following "If you do, deal 1 damage" clause and has no effect of its own.

entries.title: Poe Dameron
entries.sourceClause: Attach this upgrade to a friendly Vehicle unit without a Pilot on it.

target.text: a friendly Vehicle unit without a Pilot on it

entries.rationale: Deploy-box version: Poe attaches himself as an upgrade to a friendly Vehicle without a Pilot instead of deploying as a unit.
newVocab: attach: attach a card (unit/pilot/upgrade) to another unit as an upgrade, or move an attached upgrade

entries.title: Poe Dameron
entries.sourceClause: Flip this leader and attach him as an upgrade to a friendly Vehicle unit without a Pilot on it.

target.text: a friendly Vehicle unit without a Pilot on it

entries.rationale: Leader action: flips and attaches Poe as a Pilot upgrade to a friendly Vehicle with no Pilot, so it needs Vehicles and offers an upgrade to attach.
newVocab: attach: attach a card (unit/pilot/upgrade) to another unit as an upgrade, or move an attached upgrade

entries.title: Admiral Trench
entries.sourceClause: Draw 1 of the remaining cards and discard the other.
entries.rationale: You draw one of the two remaining revealed cards and discard the other, a draw plus a self-mill. Shape fix: mill.whose=your (self-mill of the unchosen revealed card).

entries.title: Admiral Trench
entries.sourceClause: An opponent discards 2 of them.
entries.rationale: An opponent chooses 2 of your revealed cards to go to your discard pile, so this is a self-mill the opponent controls. Shape fix: mill.whose=your (your revealed cards go to your discard).

entries.title: Admiral Trench
entries.sourceClause: Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck.

target.text: the top 4 cards of your deck

entries.rationale: Reveals the top 4 cards of your deck; the next two clauses discard and draw from them.

entries.title: Kazuda Xiono
entries.sourceClause: Take an extra action after this one.
entries.rationale: Take another action this round after this leader action, a tempo gain.
newVocab: extra_action: take an additional action after the current one

entries.title: Colossus
entries.sourceClause: Draw 1 less card in your starting hand.
entries.rationale: Base setup rule: opening hand is 1 card smaller. No in-game effect.

entries.title: Data Vault
entries.sourceClause: Your minimum deck size is increased by 10 cards.
entries.rationale: Deckbuilding rule: raises the minimum deck size by 10 cards. No in-game effect.

entries.title: Thermal Oscillator
entries.sourceClause: Your minimum deck size is decreased by 5 cards.
entries.rationale: Deckbuilding rule: lowers the minimum deck size by 5 cards. No in-game effect.

entries.title: Nabat Village
entries.sourceClause: You can't take a mulligan.
entries.rationale: Setup rule: removes the mulligan.

entries.title: Nabat Village
entries.sourceClause: Put 3 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order.
entries.rationale: First action phase: puts 3 hand cards on the bottom of the deck to offset the 3 extra starting cards; works best holding a full hand.

entries.title: Nabat Village
entries.sourceClause: Draw 3 more cards in your starting hand.
entries.rationale: Setup rule: draw 3 more cards in the starting hand. Counted as a setup rule, not a mid-game draw, so no offers:draw.

entries.title: Corvus
entries.sourceClause: You may attach a friendly Pilot unit or upgrade to this unit.

target.text: a friendly Pilot unit or upgrade

entries.rationale: When Played: optionally attaches a friendly Pilot or upgrade onto Corvus, so it wants upgrades and Pilots in the deck.
newVocab: attach: attach a card (unit/pilot/upgrade) to another unit as an upgrade, or move an attached upgrade

entries.title: Chimaera
entries.sourceClause: You may use a When Defeated ability on another friendly unit.
entries.rationale: Uses another friendly unit's When Defeated ability on demand (without defeating it), so it pairs with units carrying When Defeated.

entries.title: Annihilator
entries.sourceClause: If you do, search its controller's deck and hand for each card with that unit's name and discard them.

target.text: each card with that unit's name in its controller's deck and hand

entries.rationale: After defeating an enemy unit, strips every copy of it from its controller's deck and hand (count varN: depends on copies held).

entries.title: Admiral Yularen
entries.sourceClause: Choose Grit, Restore 1, Sentinel, or Shielded.
entries.rationale: Picks which of four keywords (Grit, Restore 1, Sentinel, Shielded) is applied by the next clause; no effect alone.

entries.title: Admiral Yularen
entries.sourceClause: While this unit is in play, each friendly Vehicle unit gains the chosen keyword.
entries.rationale: Constant while in play: all friendly Vehicles gain the keyword chosen in the previous clause. Keyword is chosen at play so n:null. Shape fix: keywords=[] because the keyword is chosen at play and not named in this clause.

entries.title: L3-37
entries.sourceClause: If this unit would be defeated, you may instead attach her as an upgrade to a friendly Vehicle unit without a Pilot on it.

target.text: a friendly Vehicle unit without a Pilot on it

entries.rationale: Replacement effect: if defeated, L3-37 becomes a Pilot upgrade on a friendly Vehicle instead, so it survives as an upgrade. Shape fix: replacement target = this unit.
newVocab: attach: attach a card (unit/pilot/upgrade) to another unit as an upgrade, or move an attached upgrade

entries.title: Phantom II
entries.sourceClause: If this card is a unit, attach it as an upgrade to The Ghost.
entries.rationale: Action from hand/play: if this is a unit it attaches as an upgrade to The Ghost, converting it into a buff upgrade. Shape fix: self_state.state=unit (this card is a unit).
newVocab: attach: attach a card (unit/pilot/upgrade) to another unit as an upgrade, or move an attached upgrade

entries.title: The Ghost
entries.sourceClause: Each other friendly Spectre unit gains this unit's keywords.
entries.rationale: Constant: shares The Ghost's keywords (varies with upgrades) to other friendly Spectres, so it wants a Spectre-heavy board. Shape fix: keywords=[] because the granted keywords are whatever this unit currently has, not named.

entries.title: Trace Martez
entries.sourceClause: You may heal 2 total damage from any number of units.
entries.rationale: Epic action: heals a total of 2 damage split among any number of units.

entries.title: U-Wing Lander

entries.rationale: After attacking, may move an upgrade from this unit to another eligible friendly Vehicle; only useful with upgrades on it.
newVocab: attach: attach a card (unit/pilot/upgrade) to another unit as an upgrade, or move an attached upgrade

entries.title: Pantoran Starship Thief
entries.sourceClause: If you do, attach this unit as an upgrade to a Fighter or Transport unit without a Pilot on it.

target.text: a Fighter or Transport unit without a Pilot on it

entries.rationale: If you paid 3 resources, this unit attaches as an upgrade to a Fighter or Transport (even an enemy one), then takes control of it in the next clause.
newVocab: attach: attach a card (unit/pilot/upgrade) to another unit as an upgrade, or move an attached upgrade

entries.title: Poe Dameron

entries.title: The Starhawk
entries.sourceClause: While paying costs, you pay half as many resources, rounded up.
entries.rationale: Constant: all costs you pay are halved rounded up, a large discount whose size varies (varN).

entries.title: Dornean Gunship
entries.sourceClause: Deal indirect damage to a player equal to the number of Vehicle units you control.

conditions.w: number of Vehicle units you control

entries.title: Dengar
entries.sourceClause: If this unit is an Underworld unit, deal 3 indirect damage instead.

conditions.w: this unit is an Underworld unit

entries.rationale: Dengar as Pilot upgrade: replaces the earlier indirect damage with 3 if the unit is Underworld.

entries.title: Devastator
entries.sourceClause: You assign all indirect damage you deal to opponents.
entries.rationale: Rules modifier: you choose how all indirect damage you deal to opponents is assigned. Changes how damage is spread, not the amount.

entries.title: Trench Run
entries.sourceClause: Deal unpreventable damage equal to the difference in the discarded cards' costs to this unit.

conditions.per: difference in the discarded cards' costs

entries.rationale: Granted ability: unpreventable damage to the attacking Fighter equal to the cost difference of two discarded cards (varN). Shape fix: scaling.per from clause.

entries.title: Hunting Aggressor
entries.sourceClause: Indirect damage you deal to opponents is increased by 1.
entries.rationale: Constant: every instance of indirect damage you deal to opponents is increased by 1. Modeled as indirect damage n:1 per instance.

entries.title: Shadow Caster
entries.sourceClause: You may use all of its When Defeated abilities again.
entries.rationale: When a friendly unit is defeated, re-runs all of its When Defeated abilities (count varN), so it wants units with When Defeated.

entries.title: Targeting Computer
entries.sourceClause: You assign all indirect damage dealt by this unit.
entries.rationale: Granted ability: attached unit's indirect damage is assigned by you. Rules modifier only.

entries.title: Planetary Bombardment
entries.sourceClause: If you control a Capital Ship unit, deal 12 indirect damage instead.
entries.rationale: Replaces the base 8 indirect damage with 12 if you control a Capital Ship. Shape fix: control.n=1 (a Capital Ship unit).

entries.title: Hound's Tooth
entries.sourceClause: While attacking an exhausted unit that didn't enter play this phase, this unit deals combat damage before the defender.

conditions.w: attacking an exhausted unit that did not enter play this phase

entries.rationale: Combat damage is dealt before the defender when attacking an exhausted unit that was in play at phase start, so it often kills without taking damage.
newVocab: first_strike: this unit deals its combat damage before the defender

entries.title: Boba Fett

entries.rationale: Replaces the earlier 1 damage with 2 if the attached unit is a Transport.

entries.title: Han Solo
entries.sourceClause: If it's the Millennium Falcon, it deals its combat damage before the defender.

conditions.w: attached unit is the Millennium Falcon

entries.rationale: If Han is played on the Millennium Falcon, it deals combat damage before the defender for the attack.
newVocab: first_strike: this unit deals its combat damage before the defender

entries.title: Commence Patrol
entries.sourceClause: Put another card in a discard pile on the bottom of its owner's deck.

target.text: another card in a discard pile

entries.rationale: Moves a card from a discard pile to the bottom of its owner's deck; the next clause (if you do) makes an X-Wing token.

entries.title: Sidon Ithano
entries.sourceClause: You may attach this unit as an upgrade to an enemy Vehicle unit without a Pilot on it.

target.text: an enemy Vehicle unit without a Pilot on it

entries.title: BoShek
entries.sourceClause: Return each of those cards with an odd cost to your hand.

target.text: each of those cards with an odd cost

entries.title: Fett's Firespray
entries.sourceClause: If you control Boba Fett, deal 2 indirect damage instead.
entries.rationale: Replaces the earlier 1 indirect damage with 2 if you control Boba Fett. Shape fix: control.n=1 (Boba Fett).

entries.title: R2-D2
entries.sourceClause: You may play or deploy 1 additional Pilot on this unit.
entries.rationale: Granted ability: attached Vehicle may take one more Pilot, enabling more Pilot upgrades. Shape fix: play_extra zone=your hand (Pilots are played or deployed from hand).

entries.title: R2-D2
entries.sourceClause: This upgrade can be played on a friendly Vehicle unit with a Pilot on it.
entries.rationale: Rules text: lets R2-D2 as an upgrade be played on a Vehicle that already has a Pilot.

entries.title: Millennium Falcon
entries.sourceClause: You may play or deploy 1 additional Pilot on this unit.
entries.rationale: Constant: Millennium Falcon can take one additional Pilot. Shape fix: play_extra zone=your hand.

entries.title: Sabine's Masterpiece
entries.sourceClause: If you control a:
entries.rationale: Clause is truncated in the source text (ends at "a:", likely the rest sits in an icon or list that was lost in normalization); effects cannot be determined without the original card. Shape fix: control.n=1; clause truncated in source.

entries.title: Retrofitted Airspeeder
entries.sourceClause: This unit can attack space units.
entries.rationale: Rules text: this ground unit may attack space units; the downside is in the next clause.

entries.title: Rey
entries.sourceClause: You may discard your hand.
entries.rationale: Deploy option: discard the entire hand (varN: hand size) to reload; feeds discard payoffs and prefers a full hand.

entries.title: Mystic Monastery
entries.sourceClause: Use this ability no more than 3 times each game.
entries.rationale: Limits the Force action to 3 uses per game.

entries.title: Nameless Terror
entries.sourceClause: Each enemy unit loses the Force trait for this phase.
entries.rationale: On attack: each enemy unit loses the Force trait this phase, turning off Force-trait synergies and restrictions.

entries.title: Kylo Ren's Lightsaber
entries.sourceClause: This unit can't be exhausted by enemy card abilities.

effects.what: be exhausted by enemy card abilities

entries.rationale: Static protection: enemy card abilities cannot exhaust the attached unit. Granted to the attached unit; no number. Shape fix: restriction.what from clause.

entries.title: Size Matters Not
entries.sourceClause: Attached unit's printed power is considered to be 5 and its printed HP is considered to be 5.
entries.rationale: Sets attached unit printed power and HP to 5 each (set, not add); n=5 is the stated value for both stats. Shape fix: stat_mod sets printed power and HP to 5 (sign=set).

entries.title: Watto
entries.sourceClause: An opponent chooses one:
entries.rationale: Header of an On Attack modal where the opponent picks which option resolves; polarity flip, no effect of its own.

entries.title: Mythosaur
entries.sourceClause: Friendly upgraded units can't be exhausted or returned to hand by enemy card abilities.

effects.what: be exhausted or returned to hand by enemy card abilities

entries.rationale: Static shield: friendly upgraded units cannot be exhausted or returned to hand by enemy card abilities; rewards upgrade-heavy boards. Shape fix: restriction.what from clause.

entries.title: Drengir Spawn
entries.sourceClause: Give a number of Experience tokens to this unit equal to the defeated unit's cost.
entries.rationale: On attack-kill, gives this unit Experience tokens equal to the defeated unit cost; varN (cost of defeated unit). Shape fix: tokens Experience, count = defeated unit's cost (varN).

entries.title: Eeth Koth
entries.sourceClause: If you do, put this card into play as a resource.
entries.rationale: After using the Force on defeat, puts this card into play as a resource (self-ramp from the defeated card).

entries.title: Luminous Beings
entries.sourceClause: Put up to 3 Force units from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck in a random order.

target.text: up to 3 Force units from your discard pile

entries.rationale: Moves up to 3 Force units from discard to the bottom of the deck in random order; deck recycling, feeds the following +4/+4 clause via "that many".
newVocab: recycle: put cards from a discard pile back into a deck (not to hand or play)

entries.title: Oppo Rancisis
entries.sourceClause: The same is true for Restore.
entries.rationale: Extends the mirror rule to Restore: gains Restore while another friendly unit has it. Restore N is not stated here, so n is null. Shape fix: keywords=Restore. while_other.w from clause.

entries.title: Oppo Rancisis
entries.sourceClause: The same is true for Grit, Hidden, Overwhelm, Saboteur, Sentinel, and Shielded.

conditions.what: another friendly unit has the keyword
conditions.w: another friendly unit has the keyword

entries.rationale: Extends the preceding Ambush mirror rule to six more keywords: this unit gains each while another friendly unit has it. varN: no magnitudes stated. Shape fix: keywords = the six listed. while_other.w from clause.

entries.title: The Burden of Masters
entries.sourceClause: Put a Force unit from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.

target.text: a Force unit from your discard pile

entries.rationale: Puts one Force unit from discard on the bottom of the deck as the cost of the following "if you do" play-a-unit clause.

entries.title: Rey
entries.sourceClause: If you control a Aggression leader or base, you may reveal this card from your hand.
entries.rationale: Optional reveal when drawn during the action phase, gated on controlling an Aggression leader or base; the revealed payoff follows in the next clause. Shape fix: control.n=1; what normalized from a string to a target object.

entries.title: Marchion Ro
entries.sourceClause: Each friendly unit's Raid is doubled.
entries.rationale: Doubles Raid on every friendly unit; scales with Raid units present. n is null because the result depends on each unit Raid value. Shape fix: keywords=Raid (doubled).

entries.title: Qui-Gon Jinn
entries.sourceClause: You may choose a non-leader ground unit.
entries.rationale: Selection step that feeds the next clause (owner tucks it). Target is any side, so it can pick a friendly or enemy unit.

entries.title: Babu Frik
entries.sourceClause: For this attack, it deals damage equal to its remaining HP instead of its power.
entries.rationale: On a Droid attack, damage dealt equals its remaining HP instead of power; benefits tough undamaged attackers and punishes damage taken. varN: remaining HP.

entries.title: The Will of the Force
entries.sourceClause: If you do, that player discards a random card from their hand.
entries.rationale: After bouncing a unit and using the Force, the unit controller discards a random card from hand.

entries.title: Jocasta Nu
entries.sourceClause: You may attach a friendly upgrade on a friendly unit to a different eligible unit.
entries.rationale: Moves a friendly upgrade from one friendly unit to another eligible unit; rewards upgrades and enables re-attachment.

entries.title: Curious Flock
entries.sourceClause: Pay up to 6 resources.
entries.rationale: Pay up to 6 resources; the following clause gives one Experience per resource paid. The payment itself has no effect; n=6 is the stated cap.

entries.title: Jabba the Hutt
entries.sourceClause: If the friendly unit has 3 or more damage on it, it deals 2 damage instead.

conditions.what: friendly unit has 3 or more damage on it

entries.rationale: Replaces the preceding 1-damage by a friendly damaged unit with 2 damage when that unit has 3+ damage; upgrade for damaged units.

entries.title: Sabé
entries.sourceClause: Look at the defending player's hand.
entries.rationale: Leader-side deploy ability: looks at the whole defending hand, then the next clauses let you discard a card from it. n null: whole hand.

entries.title: Sabé
entries.sourceClause: Discard 1 of those cards.
entries.rationale: Discards one of the two cards just looked at from the defending deck (mill-like disruption of the opponent).

entries.title: Sabé
entries.sourceClause: If you do, look at the top 2 cards of the defending player's deck.
entries.rationale: After exhausting the leader, look at the top 2 cards of the defending player deck; the next clause discards one of them.

entries.title: DJ
entries.sourceClause: Friendly units that are rescued enter play ready.
entries.rationale: Replacement-style static: rescued friendly units enter play ready rather than exhausted; pairs with capture/rescue effects.

entries.title: Darth Sion
entries.sourceClause: If this unit had 7 or more power, return him to his owner's hand.
entries.rationale: When defeated, if this unit had 7+ power it returns to hand rather than staying in discard; recursion on defeat.

entries.title: Vigil
entries.sourceClause: If damage would be dealt to this unit by another card, deal that much damage plus 1 instead.

structure.when: damage would be dealt by another card

entries.rationale: Drawback: damage dealt to this unit by another card is increased by 1. Modeled as damage n=1 on self (a vulnerability, not an offensive effect).

entries.title: Exiled from the Force
entries.sourceClause: Attached unit loses the Force trait and all abilities except for Grit.
entries.rationale: Attached unit loses the Force trait and all abilities except Grit (printed Grit is regained by the preceding clause).

entries.title: Lando Calrissian
entries.sourceClause: You may choose an enemy unit and another friendly non-leader unit.

target.text: an enemy unit and another friendly non-leader unit

entries.rationale: Chooses an enemy unit and another friendly non-leader unit; the next clause heals the base and the enemy captures the friendly unit. Shape fix: select.target = combined target; per-unit detail stays in targets[].

entries.title: PreMor Personnel Carrier
entries.sourceClause: Give this unit an Experience token for each ground unit you control.
entries.rationale: Gives this unit one Experience token per ground unit you control; varN (count of ground units). Shape fix: tokens Experience, count = ground units you control (varN).

entries.title: Director Krennic
entries.sourceClause: If it's a unit, you may return it to your hand.
entries.rationale: If the card discarded from your deck is a unit, you may return it to hand; recursion from deck-discard.

entries.title: Vuutun Palaa
entries.sourceClause: Each friendly Droid unit may be exhausted to pay costs as if it were a resource.
entries.rationale: Friendly Droid units can be exhausted as payment as if resources; ramp that scales with Droid count. varN.

entries.title: Syril Karn
entries.sourceClause: If you do, choose a unit.
entries.rationale: After disclosing aspects, choose a unit; the next clause deals 2 damage unless the controller discards a card.

entries.title: Dryden Vos
entries.sourceClause: You may double this unit's power for this attack.
entries.rationale: May double this unit power for the attack (n=null: equals current power); the drawback follows in the next clause. Shape fix: power doubled (non-numeric, 'double'); hp unchanged (0); sign=buff.

entries.title: Confidence in Victory
entries.sourceClause: At the start of the regroup phase, if you are the only player who controls units in that arena, you win the game.
entries.rationale: Alternate win condition: at start of the regroup phase, if you alone control units in the chosen arena, you win the game. Shape fix: control.n=1; what normalized to a target object.
newVocab: win_game: the controller wins the game immediately

entries.title: Confidence in Victory
entries.sourceClause: Play only as your first action in the action phase.

structure.timing: first action in the action phase

entries.rationale: Play restriction: can only be played as your first action in the action phase; no effect of its own.

entries.title: Luthen's Haulcraft
entries.sourceClause: If you do, that opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.
entries.rationale: After disclosing on defeat, the chosen opponent discards 2 cards from hand.

entries.title: Unauthorized Investigation
entries.sourceClause: If you do, create another Spy token.
entries.rationale: After disclosing Aggression, create a second Spy token (total two). Shape fix: token=Spy.

entries.title: Screeching TIE Fighter
entries.sourceClause: You may choose a ground unit.
entries.rationale: Optional selection of a ground unit (any side) to feed the next keyword-removal clause.

entries.title: Screeching TIE Fighter
entries.sourceClause: If you do, it loses its keywords for this phase.
entries.rationale: Chosen ground unit loses all its keywords for the phase; n null because it removes all keywords, not a count.

entries.title: General Grievous
entries.sourceClause: Return him to his owner's hand.
entries.rationale: When attacked, this unit returns itself to its owner hand (self-bounce to dodge damage and replay).

entries.title: The Mandalorian
entries.sourceClause: You may choose an enemy non-leader unit.
entries.rationale: Selection of an enemy non-leader unit; the next clause captures it.

entries.title: Stolen Starpath Unit
entries.sourceClause: The defending player reveals their hand.
entries.rationale: Granted ability: when the attached unit hits, the defending player reveals their hand; information only, n null (whole hand).

entries.title: Hired Slicer
entries.sourceClause: Put those cards on the bottom of that deck in a random order.
entries.rationale: Puts the two revealed cards on the bottom of that deck in random order (deck manipulation).

entries.title: Hired Slicer
entries.sourceClause: Reveal the top 2 cards of a deck.
entries.rationale: Reveals the top 2 cards of any deck; the next clause lets you exhaust a unit sharing a trait with one revealed.

entries.title: Duchess's Investigators
entries.sourceClause: If you do, each opponent discards a random card from their hand.
entries.rationale: After disclosing Cunning, each opponent discards a random card from hand.

entries.title: Elia Kane
entries.sourceClause: Look at 3 enemy resources.
entries.rationale: Looks at 3 enemy resources; the next clause may defeat one of them.

entries.title: Elia Kane
entries.sourceClause: If you do, its controller puts the top card of their deck into play as a resource and readies it.
entries.rationale: After you defeat an enemy resource, its controller replaces it with the top deck card as a ready resource; net ramp for the opponent, a drawback.

entries.title: Shipbreaking Yard
entries.sourceClause: You may return a card discarded this way to the top of your deck.
entries.rationale: After discarding 3 cards from your deck, you may put one of them back on top; self-mill with an undo.

entries.title: Obi-Wan Kenobi
entries.sourceClause: While you control 7 or more units, their printed power is considered to be 7 and printed HP is considered to be 7.
entries.rationale: While you control 7+ units, all your units have printed power and HP set to 7 (set, not add); strongly rewards wide boards. n=7 is the stated value. Shape fix: stat_mod sets printed power and HP to 7 (sign=set). what normalized from a string to a target object (tags.mjs reads what.restrict).

entries.title: Latts Razzi
entries.sourceClause: Give a Shield token or an Experience token to this unit.
entries.rationale: Gives this unit a choice of one Shield or one Experience token. Shape fix: tokens = both options (either one is given; see structure.either).

entries.title: Chio Fain
entries.sourceClause: You may choose 2 players.
entries.rationale: Chooses 2 players, who each draw a card on the following clause; symmetric draw (you and an opponent, or both opponents).

entries.title: Tear This Ship Apart
entries.sourceClause: If you do, that opponent resources the top card of their deck.
entries.rationale: If the free play happened, the opponent resources the top card of their deck: a drawback that ramps the opponent by one. Modeled as ramp with enemy side so the scorer can treat it as a cost.

entries.title: Tear This Ship Apart
entries.sourceClause: Look at all of an opponent's resources.
entries.rationale: First step of a play-from-their-resources event: reveals every enemy resource so one can be played in the next clause. Information only; the count is all of the opponent's resources.

entries.title: Max Rebo
entries.sourceClause: There is an additional regroup phase after the first regroup phase each round.
entries.rationale: Static rule change: each round has a second regroup phase (draw, resource, ready). Doubles regroup-timed effects and card flow; effect-sum scores 0, structure item marks it.
newVocab: extra_phase: structure item, the card adds an extra game phase each round

entries.title: Maz Kanata
entries.sourceClause: At the start of the regroup phase, put that unit on the bottom of your deck.
entries.rationale: Delayed trigger: at the start of the next regroup phase the unit played by the search goes to the bottom of its owner's deck. It is a temporary unit (tuck of a friendly unit), so it drops out of play at end of round.

entries.title: Interrogation Droid
entries.sourceClause: If you do and that unit costs 3 or less, its controller discards a card from their hand.
entries.rationale: Conditional on the exhaust succeeding and the enemy unit costing 3 or less: its controller discards a card of their choice from hand. Opponent-choice discard.

entries.title: Luke Skywalker
entries.sourceClause: An opponent chooses one:
entries.rationale: Modal header where the opponent picks which option resolves, so the owner gets the less favorable one. Option effects are parsed separately; this only flips the polarity to opponent-choice.
newVocab: opponent_chooses_mode: structure item, opponent selects the modal option

entries.title: Krrsantan
entries.sourceClause: Return this unit to your hand.
entries.rationale: Returns itself to its owner's hand, usually as a cost or escape; re-triggers its own When Played if replayed.

entries.title: The Stranger
entries.sourceClause: While attacking, you may have the defending unit deal combat damage before this unit.

structure.what: defender deals combat damage first, optional

entries.rationale: Optional combat-order change: the defender deals damage first, letting this unit avoid taking damage if the defender dies or to sequence kills. Mostly a downside lever; no stat or resource change.

entries.title: Kanan Jarrus
entries.sourceClause: If you control a Command or Aggression unit, you may return a non-leader unit that costs 4 or less instead.

target.text: a non-leader unit that costs 4 or less

entries.rationale: Upgraded version of the previous clause: with a Command or Aggression unit, the bounce threshold rises from cost 2 to cost 4. Any non-leader unit, friend or enemy, so it doubles as removal or a replay enabler. Shape fix: control.n=1; what normalized to a target object.

entries.title: Choke on Aspirations
entries.sourceClause: If it survives, heal damage from your base equal to the damage dealt this way.
entries.rationale: Heals your base by the damage dealt to your own unit if it survived; n equals the damage dealt (up to 5), so varN. Shape fix: scaling.per from clause.

entries.title: Display Piece
entries.sourceClause: Its controller resources it from its owner's discard pile.

target.text: it, from its owner's discard pile

entries.rationale: The defeated enemy unit goes to its controller's resources instead of staying in the discard; the opponent gains a resource. A drawback attached to the defeat.

entries.title: Rodian Bondsman
entries.sourceClause: Each player creates a Credit token.
entries.rationale: Symmetric: both players create one Credit token. Credits are spendable currency; the opponent gains the same as you, so net value is the tempo of getting your Credit first. Shape fix: token=Credit. token=Credit.

entries.title: Rogue One
entries.sourceClause: Put any number of them on the bottom of your deck and the rest on top in any order.

target.text: the top 2 cards of your deck

structure.what: any number to bottom, rest on top in any order

entries.rationale: Continuation of looking at the top 2: choose which go to the bottom and order the rest. Deck manipulation (scry), number moved is the player's choice.

entries.title: Watchful
entries.sourceClause: Look at the top card of a deck.
entries.rationale: Granted ability: look at the top card of either player's deck. Information gain.

entries.title: Watchful
entries.sourceClause: You may put it on the bottom of that deck.
entries.rationale: Optional follow-up: put the looked-at card on the bottom of that deck. Quality control on your draws or denial on the opponent's.

entries.title: Adventurer Sniper Rifle
entries.sourceClause: Its printed HP is considered to be 1 for this phase.
entries.rationale: Granted ability sets the printed HP of the unit it hits to 1 for the phase, making the target easy to finish (HP set, not reduced). Duration this phase. Shape fix: printed HP set to 1 (sign=set); power untouched (null).

entries.title: Betrayed Trust
entries.sourceClause: For this phase, that unit can't deal combat damage.
entries.rationale: Prevents the chosen enemy unit from dealing combat damage this phase: a defensive tempo restriction. Shape fix: restriction.what from clause.

entries.title: Targeted For Removal
entries.sourceClause: An opponent creates Credit tokens equal to this unit's cost.

target.text: Credit tokens equal to this unit's cost

entries.rationale: Granted ability (when the attached unit is defeated or triggers) gives an opponent Credit tokens equal to the unit's cost; n varies by unit cost. A drawback on the carrier, so the opponent gets currency. Shape fix: token=Credit. scaling.per from clause.

entries.title: Hunter For Hire
entries.sourceClause: Any player may use this ability.
entries.rationale: Symmetric-access flag: either player may use the take-control ability, so control of this unit swaps back and forth.
newVocab: shared_ability: structure item, ability usable by any player

entries.title: Expendable Mercenary
entries.sourceClause: You may resource this unit from its owner's discard pile.

target.text: this unit, from its owner's discard pile

entries.rationale: From the discard pile, turn this unit into a resource; recovers value from a dead copy and ramps by one. Needs to be in the discard pile.

entries.title: The Sarlacc of Carkoon
entries.sourceClause: Put a unit from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.

target.text: a unit from your discard pile

entries.rationale: Cost-like first step: move a unit from your discard pile to the bottom of your deck; the next clause deals damage equal to that unit's power.

entries.title: Double-Cross
entries.sourceClause: Exchange control of those units.
entries.rationale: Swaps control of the chosen friendly and enemy non-leader units. Exchanging a weak/exhausted unit for a better enemy unit is card advantage; modeled as take_control of 2. Shape fix: toOpponent=false (an exchange, not a one-way give).

entries.title: Stockpile
entries.sourceClause: Resource this event and the top card of your deck.

target.text: this event and the top card of your deck

entries.rationale: Puts the event and the top card of your deck into your resource zone: 2 resources gained for one card.

entries.sourceClause: You may put a Aggression card from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.

target.text: an Aggression card from your discard pile

entries.rationale: Optional cost: put an Aggression card from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck; the if you do clause then deals damage to enemy bases.

entries.title: Doctor Aphra
entries.sourceClause: You may return an Underworld card discarded this way to your hand.

target.text: an Underworld card discarded this way

entries.rationale: After discarding 3 from the top of the deck, you may return one Underworld card among them to hand. Self-mill with selection.

entries.title: Daring Delve
entries.sourceClause: You may return a Aggression card discarded this way to your hand.

target.text: an Aggression card discarded this way

entries.rationale: After discarding 2 from the deck, you may return one Aggression card among them to hand: tutor-like selection via self-mill.

entries.title: Vermillion
entries.sourceClause: If this unit survived, reveal the top card of a deck, then choose a player.
entries.rationale: Reveal the top card of either deck, then choose which player may play it for free. Next clause lets that player play it; this clause is the setup. Shape fix: self_state.state=survived.

entries.title: Vermillion
entries.sourceClause: If they do, a different player creates Credit tokens equal to that card's cost.

target.text: Credit tokens equal to that card's cost

entries.rationale: If the chosen player played it, a different player gets Credits equal to that card's cost (compensation). n equals the revealed card's cost. Shape fix: token=Credit. scaling.per from clause.

entries.title: Anakin's Podracer
entries.sourceClause: While attacking, if no other units have attacked this phase, this unit deals combat damage before the defending unit.

structure.what: this unit deals combat damage first

entries.rationale: Conditional first strike: if no other unit attacked this phase, this unit deals damage before the defender, avoiding retaliation when it wins. Rarely active mid-phase.

entries.title: Qui-Gon Jinn
entries.sourceClause: Put the rest back on top in any order.

structure.what: rest back on top in any order

entries.rationale: Reorders the remaining looked-at cards on top of the deck. Pure information/ordering.

entries.title: Qui-Gon Jinn
entries.sourceClause: You may discard 1 of them.
entries.rationale: From the top 3 cards you looked at, you may discard one (self-mill with selection).

entries.title: Scavenging Sandcrawler
entries.sourceClause: You may put a card from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.

target.text: a card from your discard pile

entries.rationale: Optional cost: put a discard card on the bottom of your deck; the if you do clause creates a Credit token.

entries.title: Improvise
entries.sourceClause: If you don't, you may discard it.
entries.rationale: If you did not play the card, you may discard it; the fallback so you do not get stuck with it on top.

entries.title: Improvise
entries.sourceClause: You may play it.
entries.rationale: Optionally play the top card you looked at; the next clause discounts it by 1. Shape fix: play_extra zone=your deck (top card looked at).

entries.title: Fire Across the Galaxy
entries.sourceClause: Use any number of When Played abilities on friendly Spectre units.
entries.rationale: Trigger When Played abilities of any number of friendly Spectre units; n depends on board state.

entries.title: Sabine Wren
entries.sourceClause: An opponent gives 2 Advantage tokens to a unit they control.

target.text: 2 Advantage tokens to a unit they control

entries.rationale: Opponent gives 2 Advantage tokens to one of their own units: a cost-like drawback that buffs an enemy unit; the next clause rewards you if they do. Shape fix: token=Advantage.

entries.title: Moff Gideon
entries.sourceClause: Ambush, Grit, Hidden, Overwhelm, Saboteur, Sentinel, Shielded, Support.
entries.rationale: Deployed leader has the listed keywords (a bare keyword list). n is 8 keywords. Shape fix: keywords = the eight listed.

entries.title: Emperor Palpatine
entries.sourceClause: You may choose another exhausted friendly unit.
entries.rationale: Deployed leader may repeat the target step on another exhausted friendly unit; the following clause gives another Advantage token. Shape fix: tokens Advantage (per rationale: the following clause gives another Advantage token).

entries.title: Hera Syndulla
entries.sourceClause: If this unit dealt combat damage to a base, heal that much damage from your base.

conditions.what: dealt combat damage to a base

conditions.per: combat damage dealt to a base

entries.rationale: Heals your base by the combat damage this unit dealt to a base; amount equals that damage. Shape fix: scaling.per from clause.

entries.title: Red Leader
entries.sourceClause: This unit may attack units in either arena.
entries.rationale: Lets this unit attack units in either arena instead of only its own; flexibility.
newVocab: attack_any_arena: structure item, can attack ground and space units

entries.title: Reanimated Night Trooper
entries.sourceClause: You may discard it.
entries.rationale: Optionally discard the looked-at card; controls your next draw or denies the opponent's. Shape fix: mill.whose=your (consistent with offers:discard-own).

entries.title: Reanimated Night Trooper
entries.sourceClause: Look at the top card of a deck.
entries.rationale: Look at the top card of either deck, then (next clause) choose to discard it.

entries.title: Chimaera
entries.sourceClause: You may choose a friendly unit and an enemy non-leader unit.

structure.what: friendly unit and enemy non-leader unit

entries.rationale: Optional target selection for a defeat both units trade: you sacrifice a friendly unit to kill an enemy non-leader. The defeat is in the next clause; offers set here because the pair is a sac outlet.

entries.title: At Attin Safety Droid
entries.sourceClause: If your base would be dealt more than 4 damage, prevent all but 4 of that damage.

conditions.what: base would be dealt more than 4 damage

entries.rationale: Replacement effect: caps damage to your base at 4 per instance by preventing the excess. n varies with the hit. Shape fix: replacement target = your base.

entries.title: Ryder Azadi
entries.sourceClause: While this unit is in play, opponents can't play cards with that name.
entries.rationale: While in play, opponents cannot play cards with the named card name: a lock-out of one card. Shape fix: restriction.what from clause. while_other.w from clause.

entries.title: Arcana Star Map
entries.sourceClause: If you would search a number of cards from your deck, search twice that number of cards instead.

conditions.what: you would search a number of cards

entries.rationale: Replacement effect doubling the number of cards you search from your deck; multiplier 2 on whatever number a search effect gives. Shape fix: search.for=cards, upTo=null (no cap). replacement target = you (the searching player).

entries.title: Moff Jerjerrod
entries.sourceClause: If you do, create twice that number of tokens instead.
entries.rationale: If you defeated this unit, create double the tokens instead. Multiplier 2; trade the unit for double tokens. Shape fix: token='token': the clause names no specific token type. replacement target = you (the token-creating player).

entries.title: Queen Soruna
entries.sourceClause: You may reveal a unit from your hand.
entries.rationale: Optional cost: reveal a unit from hand; if you do, deal 3 damage to a unit with the same cost. Reveal does not discard.

entries.title: The Darksaber
entries.sourceClause: While you are paying costs, this unit provides its aspect icons.
entries.rationale: The attached unit counts as providing its aspect icons when you pay costs, so it helps other cards avoid aspect penalties. Modelled as an aspect-penalty reducer; n is not a number in the text. Shape fix: while_other.w from clause.
newVocab: aspect_icons_provider: structure marker for a permanent source of aspect icons

entries.title: Wipe Them Out
entries.sourceClause: For this attack, you may deal its excess damage to another unit in the same arena.

target.text: another unit in the same arena

entries.rationale: During the attack this event grants, excess damage past the defender spills onto another unit in the same arena (trample-like). Amount is the variable excess, so n is null.

entries.title: Hold Them Off
entries.sourceClause: That unit deals damage equal to its power divided as you choose among any number of units in its arena.

target.text: any number of units in its arena

entries.rationale: The chosen unit deals damage equal to its power, divided as you choose among units in its arena; amount is variable (power), so n is null. Shape fix: scaling.per from clause.

entries.title: Ninth Sister
entries.sourceClause: You may deal damage equal to its cost divided as you choose among any number of units.
entries.rationale: Optional divided damage equal to the cost of the unit referred to earlier, split among any units. Amount varies with that cost. Shape fix: scaling.per from clause.

entries.title: Deadly Vulnerability
entries.sourceClause: If attached unit would take damage, it takes twice as much damage instead.
entries.rationale: Replacement effect that doubles damage the attached unit takes; a liability on a friendly unit, a damage amplifier on an enemy unit. The effect list stays damage with n null since the extra damage is conditional. Shape fix: replacement target = attached unit.
newVocab: damage_multiplier: structure marker, multiplies damage taken by n

entries.title: Rash Action
entries.sourceClause: If this unit dealt combat damage to an opponent's base, that opponent discards a card.

conditions.text: this unit dealt combat damage to an opponent's base

entries.rationale: Granted ability on the attacking unit: if it hit the enemy base with combat damage, the defending opponent discards a card.

entries.title: Reckless Sacrifice
entries.sourceClause: Discard a unit from your hand.
entries.rationale: Cost-like discard of a unit from your own hand; feeds discard payoffs.

entries.title: Helgait
entries.sourceClause: You may distribute a number of Advantage tokens equal to this unit's power among friendly units.
entries.rationale: Distributes Advantage tokens equal to this unit's power among friendly units. Count varies with power, so n is null. Shape fix: tokens Advantage, count = this unit's power (varN). scaling.per from clause.

entries.title: Gorian Shard's Corsair
entries.sourceClause: Damage dealt by friendly Underworld cards is unpreventable.
entries.rationale: Static: damage dealt by friendly Underworld cards cannot be prevented, which counters shields-like prevention. Pairs with Underworld cards. Not a prevention for you, the reverse.
newVocab: damage_unpreventable: structure marker for damage that cannot be prevented

entries.title: Carson Teva
entries.sourceClause: While attacking, this unit deals combat damage before the defender.
entries.rationale: While attacking, this unit deals combat damage before the defender, so it can kill the defender without taking damage back. Shape fix: self_state.state=attacking.
newVocab: combat_damage_first: structure marker, deals combat damage before the opponent

entries.title: Fateful Goodbye
entries.sourceClause: If a friendly leader unit left play this phase, distribute 5 Advantage tokens instead.

conditions.text: a friendly leader unit left play this phase

entries.rationale: Upgrade of the previous clause: if a friendly leader unit left play, distribute 5 tokens instead of 3. Shape fix: tokens Advantage x5.

entries.title: Fateful Goodbye
entries.sourceClause: If a friendly unit left play this phase, distribute 3 Advantage tokens among friendly units.

conditions.text: a friendly unit left play this phase

entries.rationale: Event pays off a friendly unit leaving play this phase by distributing 3 Advantage tokens among friendly units. Shape fix: tokens Advantage x3.

entries.title: Jod Na Nawood
entries.sourceClause: If you do, choose an arena.
entries.rationale: Follows paying 4 resources; picks the arena that the next clause exhausts every unit in. Only a choice step, no effect of its own.

entries.title: Elzar Mann
entries.sourceClause: Then, an opponent searches twice that many cards from the top of their deck for an event, reveals it, and draws it.

conditions.text: twice the number of tokens distributed

entries.rationale: The opponent digs twice as many cards deep as tokens given and draws an event. A drawback that gives the opponent card selection; count varies, so n is null. Shape fix: search.for=an event, upTo=null. scaling.per from clause (twice the tokens distributed).

entries.title: Elzar Mann
entries.sourceClause: Distribute up to 5 Advantage tokens among other friendly units.
entries.rationale: Distributes up to 5 Advantage tokens among other friendly units. Shape fix: tokens Advantage up to 5.

entries.title: Improvised Identity
entries.sourceClause: For this attack, this unit gains the discarded unit's abilities.
entries.rationale: For this attack the attached unit copies the abilities of the unit discarded earlier in the sequence.

entries.title: Mos Espa Watermonger
entries.sourceClause: If you do, discard a card.
entries.rationale: Loot: after the optional draw, discard a card.

entries.title: Asajj Ventress
entries.sourceClause: For this attack, replace any Raid it has or gains with Restore, or vice versa.
entries.rationale: Swaps Raid for Restore (or Restore for Raid) on the attacking unit for this attack; no numbers stated. Shape fix: keywords = Restore and Raid (swap).
newVocab: swap_keyword: structure marker, converts one keyword into another

entries.title: Asajj Ventress
entries.sourceClause: For this attack, replace any Raid it has or gains with Restore, or vice versa.
entries.rationale: Swaps Raid for Restore (or Restore for Raid) on the attacking unit for this attack; no numbers stated. Shape fix: keywords = Restore and Raid (swap).
newVocab: swap_keyword: structure marker, converts one keyword into another

entries.title: Osha
entries.sourceClause: If you do, you may resource a card from your hand.
entries.rationale: After playing a Villainy unit from resources, optionally put a card from hand into resources as a new resource.

entries.title: Osha
entries.sourceClause: If you do, you may resource a card from your hand.
entries.rationale: After playing a Villainy unit from resources, optionally put a card from hand into resources as a new resource.

entries.title: Hunter
entries.sourceClause: Choose two.
entries.rationale: Modal header: pick two of the listed options.

entries.title: Hunter
entries.sourceClause: You may choose the same option more than once:
entries.rationale: The modal choices may repeat the same option more than once.

entries.title: Kelnacca
entries.sourceClause: You may pay any number of resources.
entries.rationale: Optional variable payment of resources that feeds the next clause (damage per 3 resources paid). Amount chosen at play time.

entries.title: Bacta Tank
entries.sourceClause: Put a non‑Vehicle unit from your discard pile on top of your deck.

target.text: a non-Vehicle unit from your discard pile

entries.rationale: Puts a non-Vehicle unit from your discard on top of your deck, a recursion to redraw it.

entries.title: Keeper of Skara Nal
entries.sourceClause: You may discard 2 cards named Keeper of Skara Nal from your hand.

target.text: 2 cards named Keeper of Skara Nal

entries.rationale: Optional additional cost of discarding two copies of this card from hand to power up the attack. Uses a copy-heavy deck.

entries.title: Dooku
entries.sourceClause: If you do, heal damage from a base equal to that unit's cost.
entries.rationale: After readying a unit, heals a base for damage equal to that unit's cost; amount varies. Shape fix: scaling.per from clause.

entries.title: Ima-Gun Di
entries.sourceClause: If you control fewer resources than an opponent, you may resource a card from your hand.

conditions.text: you control fewer resources than an opponent

entries.rationale: Catch-up ramp: when behind on resources, optionally resource a card from hand. Shape fix: control_resources.n=0: comparative ('fewer than an opponent'), no fixed count.

entries.title: Vernestra Rwoh
entries.sourceClause: This unit gains those units' When Played abilities for this phase.
entries.rationale: Copies the When Played abilities of the units put on the deck bottom as additional cost, for this phase; the number of units is variable (up to 2).

entries.title: Low Altitude Combat
entries.sourceClause: Move a space unit to the ground arena.
entries.rationale: Moves a space unit to the ground arena. No damage or removal, a repositioning step that exposes it to ground interaction.
newVocab: move_unit_arena: structure marker for moving a unit between arenas

entries.title: Fett's Firespray
entries.sourceClause: Friendly units can attack bases while using Ambush.
entries.rationale: Friendly units that use Ambush may attack bases instead of only units; widens the Ambush keyword.
newVocab: ambush_can_attack_bases: structure marker, lets Ambush attacks target bases

entries.title: Yoda
entries.sourceClause: You may put this card from your discard pile on top of your deck.
entries.rationale: Lets Yoda return from the discard pile to the top of the deck, setting up a redraw.

entries.title: Boss Lyonie
entries.sourceClause: You may choose a token upgrade attached to another unit.
entries.rationale: Selects a token upgrade on another unit so the next clause can copy it.
newVocab: choose_token_upgrade: structure marker, targeting a token upgrade

entries.title: Boss Lyonie
entries.sourceClause: Give another one of those tokens to that unit.
entries.rationale: Gives a second copy of the chosen token upgrade to the target unit. Shape fix: tokens Experience x1: 'those tokens' type is not in this clause; Experience matches the existing offers tag.

entries.title: Ravage
entries.sourceClause: Distribute up to 3 Weakness tokens among any number of units.
entries.rationale: Distributes up to 3 Weakness tokens (-X/-X) among any number of units. Shape fix: tokens Weakness up to 3.

entries.title: The First Legion
entries.sourceClause: Enemy cards, including those not in play, lose that trait for this phase.
entries.rationale: Enemy cards lose the named trait this phase, including cards outside play, which can turn off trait synergies.

entries.title: The First Legion
entries.sourceClause: Name a trait.
entries.rationale: Names a trait, which the next clause removes from enemy cards.
newVocab: name_trait: structure marker, player names a trait

entries.title: The Marauder
entries.sourceClause: While playing this unit, you may choose any number of friendly units.
entries.rationale: While being played, you may choose any number of friendly units, as a setup step for the effect that follows or precedes. Count depends on your board.

entries.title: Zam Wesell
entries.sourceClause: This unit gains each friendly leader's traits except Force, even while she's not in play.
entries.rationale: This unit gains every trait on friendly leaders except Force, even while she is out of play, so she can satisfy trait payoffs. Shape fix: keywords=[]: the clause grants traits, not keywords (no trait effect cat exists).
newVocab: gains_traits: structure marker, unit gains traits

entries.title: Overgrowth
entries.sourceClause: Resource this card.
entries.rationale: After resolving the event, this card becomes a resource instead of going to discard.

entries.title: Raze to Ruin
entries.sourceClause: Each player discards all but 3 cards from their hand.
entries.rationale: Symmetric hand reduction to 3 cards. Discard count varies with hand size, so n is null. Shape fix: scaling.per from clause (all but 3 cards).

entries.title: Stormchaser
entries.sourceClause: You may reveal a Disaster card from your hand.
entries.rationale: Optionally reveal a Disaster card from hand, which enables the draw in the next clause.

entries.title: Ty Yorrick
entries.sourceClause: If a friendly ability would deal damage, you may have that ability deal that much damage plus 1 instead.

conditions.text: a friendly ability would deal damage

entries.rationale: Replacement effect: friendly abilities may deal 1 extra damage, which boosts damage-dealing abilities and event. Shape fix: replacement target = a friendly ability.
newVocab: damage_plus: structure marker, adds n to damage dealt

entries.title: Giant Gorax
entries.sourceClause: If you control an Endor base, each opponent chooses one:
entries.rationale: Header of an opponent-chosen modal. The options are separate clauses. Shape fix: control n=1, what = an Endor base.

entries.title: Qimir
entries.sourceClause: You may discard the top card of your deck.

target.text: the top card of your deck

entries.rationale: Optionally mills your own top card, to check its aspect for the next clause. Shape fix: mill.whose=your.

entries.title: New Tactics
entries.sourceClause: Its owner puts it on the top or bottom of their deck.
entries.rationale: Same tuck as Qui-Gon Jinn: the chosen non-leader unit goes to top or bottom of its owner's deck, chosen by that owner.

entries.title: Ritual Dragon
entries.sourceClause: While you control a Tatooine base, friendly units enter play ready.
entries.rationale: Static: with a Tatooine base, your units enter play ready, so they can attack at once. Shape fix: control n=1, what = a Tatooine base.
newVocab: enters_ready: structure marker, units enter play ready
